The '''Chommell sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]].

==History==
Thirty-six [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of the Chommell sector were members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> and were successively represented by a [[Unidentified Naboo senator|senator]], [[Vidar Kim]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]], [[Horace Vancil/Legends|Horace Vancil]], and finally [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the final years of the Republic.<ref name="DBJG">{{DB|character|janusgreejatus|Greejatus, Janus}}</ref> The sector had 36 full-member worlds plus an additional 40,000 settled dependencies and 300,000,000 barren [[Star/Legends|stars]] and even in such a sparsely populated sector, a thorough home constituency tour for the local Senator could take a lifetime.<ref name="AOTC:ICS" /> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Chommell sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|captainpanaka|Panaka, Captain}}</ref> a long-time associate of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine,<ref name="ITW:OT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> and represented by [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and later [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> and [[Boma (Gungan)|Boma]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Some sources use an alternate spelling of '''''Chommel'''''. [[Leland Chee]] has stated that ''Chommell'' is the correct spelling.<ref name="SW Forums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=158725&start=97#11593602|thread=Spelling Discrepancies|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2005-06-27|time=10:12 AM}}</ref>
